# Bradford - council briefing

*Auto-generated from council minutes, 29 April 2026 to 1 August 2026*

## What's dominating the agenda

Finance & Budget leads with 2,827 keyword hits, mostly via the Executive and Corporate Overview and Scrutiny Committee, followed by Transport & Highways (2,480) and Children & Education (2,228, largely Schools Forum). One data note: Bradford also publishes thousands of statutory traffic notices (Traffic Regulation Orders, parking orders) through the same system - these are excluded from the counts above as administrative paperwork rather than committee debate.

## Notable decisions

- The Executive approved disposal of a council-owned asset to the recommended purchaser, following a three-month marketing process that produced an offer above the guide price (key decision, approved, 6 Jul).
- The Executive signed off the year-end financial position for 2025-26, confirming spending stayed within approved budgets (key decision, 9 Jun).
- The Governance and Audit Committee approved recommendations on the council's counter-fraud arrangements (23 Jul, approved).
- The Governance and Audit Committee reviewed the corporate risk register and endorsed de-escalating several identified risks (23 Jul, approved).
- A licence application for the Love Apple Cafe Bar in Shipley was granted (22 Jul, approved).
- Bradford West Area Committee reviewed how Capital Highway Maintenance funding is allocated across non-classified roads in the area (22 Jul, approved).

- An annual update on road safety education, training and publicity across the district went to Bradford West Area Committee (22 Jul). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1524446/file)
- Schools Forum met to review schools funding allocations for the district (8 Jul). [source](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1505968/file)

## Projects on residents' radar

- **Squire Lane Sports and Leisure Facility** - the Executive discontinued this proposed new swimming and leisure facility because of its financial costs, after reviewing the business case (21 Jul). [source](https://bradford.moderngov.co.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=7728)
- **Westgate Bus Hotspot scheme** - the Executive approved this bus priority scheme as its preferred delivery approach, to be funded through City Region Sustainable Transport Settlements money (21 Jul). [source](https://bradford.moderngov.co.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=7725)
- **Heritage Action Zone Capital Grant Scheme** - the council awarded a contract to architectural consultants to work on this scheme, funded by £2m from Historic England (5 May). [source](https://bradford.moderngov.co.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=7620)
- **Thornton Road/Listerhills Road signals upgrade** - the Bradford West Area Committee reviewed Traffic Regulation Order proposals for this junction scheme, including a possible one-way system on the slip road linking the two roads (22 Jul). [source](https://bradford.moderngov.co.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=7734)
- **Keighley Towns Fund** - the Keighley and Ilkley Area Committee reviewed progress on Towns Fund projects delivered under the town's Town Investment Plan, alongside the related Pride in Place programme (5 Mar). [source](https://bradford.moderngov.co.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=7502)
